prompt: What does the 'test' dependency scope mean?
choices: The dependency is only available at compile time
The dependency is available everywhere including production
The dependency is only on the classpath during testing and is not packaged
The dependency is downloaded only when tests fail
explanation: Scope 'test' restricts the dependency to the test compile and test runtime classpaths. JUnit and Mockito are typical test-scoped dependencies — they must not ship in the production JAR.
